import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(22.9, 26.8)
    .faces("<Z")
    .chamfer(1.0)
    .faces(">Z")
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polarArray(20.9, 0, 360, 6)
    .hole(3.2)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 12.75), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(2.6, 15.4)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 27.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(27.5, 12.0)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(11.2)
)
result = result.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90)
show_object(result)

import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(22.9, 26.8)
    .faces("<Z")
    .chamfer(1.0)
    .faces(">Z")
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .polarArray(20.9, 0, 360, 6)
    .hole(3.2)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 12.75), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(2.6, 15.4)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 27.8), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(27.5, 12.0)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(11.2)
)
result = cq.Workplane("XY").newObject([result.val().moved(cq.Location(cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), cq.Vector(1, 0, 0), 90))])
